title: The Relativistic Law of Velocity Addition
printed_title: **98. 速度合成的相对论定律**

prose.text:
The new law of velocity addition agrees with the relativistic concepts of space and time.
The classical law cannot be generally valid because it conflicts with the constancy of the speed of light in vacuum.
prose.source_text: 速度合成的新定律是符合于空间和时间的相对论新概念的. 很明显，速度合成的经典定律不可能是正确的，因为它与真空中光速是恒量的论点相矛盾.

prose.text:
Suppose a train moves at speed $v$ and a light wave travels inside the carriage in the direction of the train's motion.
The speed of the light wave relative to Earth must still be $c$, **not** $v+c$.
The new law of velocity addition must also give this result.
prose.source_text: 如果火车以速度 $v$ 运行，并且在车厢中在火车运动的方向上有一光波传播着，则光波相对于地球的速度应当仍然还是 $c$，**而不是** $v+c$. 速度合成的新定律也应该导出所要求的结果.

prose.text:
We state, without proof, the law for the special case of collinear motion.
An object moves along the motion axis of reference frame $K_1$, while reference frame $K_1$ moves relative to reference frame $K$ at velocity $v$.
Throughout the motion, the axes $X$ and $X_1$ remain coincident, while $Y$ and $Y_1$, and $Z$ and $Z_1$, remain parallel respectively (Figure 226).
prose.source_text: 我们写出（不加证明）个别情况下的速度合成定律：*当物**体沿参考系 $K_1$ 的轴运动，而参考系 $K_1$ 又相对于参考系 $K$ 以**速度 $v$ 运动，并且，在运动过程中坐标轴 $X$ 与 $X_1$ 始终是重合**的，而坐标轴 $Y$ 和 $Y_1$，$Z$ 和 $Z_1$ 始**终是保持平行的（图 226）.*

prose.text:
Let $v_1$ denote the object's velocity relative to $K_1$, and let $v_2$ denote the same object's velocity relative to $K$.
The relativistic law of velocity addition gives:
$v_2=\frac{v_1+v}{1+\frac{v_1v}{c^2}}$ (8.6)
prose.source_text: 我们用 $v_1$ 表示*物体相对于**$K_1$ 的速度*，用 $v_2$ 表示*此物体相**对于 $K$ 的速度*. 这时根据速度合成的相对论定律$v_2=\frac{v_1+v}{1+\frac{v_1v}{c^2}}$　（8.6）

prose.text: Figure 226
prose.label: 图 226

prose.text:
When $v\ll c$ and $v_1\ll c$, the term $\frac{v_1v}{c^2}$ in the denominator can be neglected.
Equation (8.6) then reduces approximately to the classical law of velocity addition:
$v_2=v_1+v$.
prose.source_text: 如果 $v\ll c$，$v_1\ll c$，则项 $\frac{v_1v}{c^2}$ 在分母中可以忽略不计，我们得出的不是(8.6)式，而是速度合成的经典定律：$v_2=v_1+v$

prose.text:
When $v_1=c$, the velocity $v_2$ also equals $c$, as required by the second postulate of relativity.
Substitution gives:
$v_2=\frac{c+v}{1+\frac{cv}{c^2}}=c\frac{c+v}{c+v}=c$.
prose.source_text: 当 $v_1=c$ 时，速度 $v_2$ 也等于 $c$，正如相对论第二假设要求的那样，确实是，$v_2=\frac{c+v}{1+\frac{cv}{c^2}}=c\frac{c+v}{c+v}=c$

prose.text:
A notable property of the relativistic law is that, for the allowed speeds $v_1$ and $v$ (neither greater than $c$), the resulting speed $v_2$ does not exceed $c$.
In the formal limiting case $v_1=v=c$, we obtain:
$v_2=\frac{2c}{2}=c$.
prose.source_text: 速度合成的相对论定律的突出性质是，在速度 $v_1$ 和 $v$ 为任何值时(当然不能大于 $c$)合速度 $v_2$ 不超过 $c$，在极限情况下，当 $v_1=v=c$ 时，可得$v_2=\frac{2c}{2}=c$

prose.text:
A speed $v>c$ is impossible.
For $v>c$, equations (8.1) and (8.2) lose their physical meaning because the calculated time and length become imaginary.
prose.source_text: 速度 $v>c$ 是不可能的. 当 $v>c$ 时，公式(8.1)和(8.2)就失去意义，因为时间和长度变为虚数了.

prose.text: **The speed of light is the maximum possible speed for transmitting interactions in nature**.
prose.source_text: **光速是自然界中传递相互作用的最大可能速度.**
